\section{Catalog snippets}\label{sec:catalog}
See Section~\ref{sec:catalog}. \emph{Representative} \textbf{offline} entries.
\procedureblock{Sample}{
  x \sample \bin \\
  y \gets x \\
  \pcif y=1 \pcthen \\
    y \gets 0 \\
  \pcfi \\
  \pcfor i \pcin \{1,2\} \pcdo \\
    y \sample \bin \\
  \pcendfor \\
  \pcwhile y=0 \pcdo \\
    y \sample \bin \\
  \pcendwhile \\
  \pcreturn y
}
